== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Lothal (Dark) (Errata)]]: Left: the image of [[Lothal (Dark)]] (published 10 August 2022, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/25528d7b73b5e6206de765d700504be693fc39da/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual19-Dark/large/lothal.gif holotable 25528d7]); right: the image of [[Lothal (Dark) (Errata)]] (published 12 December 2022, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual19-Dark/large/lothal.gif holotable 12d0bca]). Same area (x 28–661, y 0–977) cropped from each published image <code>lothal.gif</code>; pixels unchanged. Made by placing the two unscaled crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).
